messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate observed for Everdawn on dedicated-eu-cluster-3. Triggered paging policy v2 at 2024-09-12T14:33:27Z. Current error rate ~12% (baseline <0.5%).

ashley_sre: I'm on it — looking at model runtime logs and GPU telemetry. starting systemic triage.

mike_oncall: I'm the pager. Ashley, call if you need escalation. I'll prep the customer brief for CS.

ashley_sre: quick checks: 
```
# check recent tail of inference logs
kubectl -n redwood logs svc/serve-dedicated-eu-3 --since=30m | grep ERROR | tail -n 200
# check node GPU memory and process list
ssh gpunode-12 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv'
```

ashley_sre: early signal points to elevated KV cache eviction + OOMs on a subset of pods after a recent model rollout (v1.7.2 -> v1.8.0). I'm rolling back the model on affected pool to v1.7.2 on a canary subset now.

incident-bot: Deployment rollback initiated by ashley_sre: rollback id rlbk-1768810001 — target: dedicated-eu-cluster-3 (canary first).

julia_cs: Drafting tailored customer notification for Everdawn — team needs wording + impact window + contact routing. Posting suggested blurb below for review.

julia_cs: Suggested CS / customer-facing message (short):
"Everdawn team — we detected increased request errors affecting your Dedicated EU cluster starting ~14:33 UTC. Our SREs have identified a model rollout as a likely cause and initiated a rollback; mitigation is in progress. We expect reduced errors within 30–45 minutes. We'll send a follow-up when service is restored or if ETA changes. Primary contact: evelyn@everdawn.co. For urgent questions reply to this thread or contact your account engineer. — Redwood Inference"

account-eng-evelyn: Please add: impact to SLA metrics (requests may fail intermittently; no data loss). Also include advisory for retry/backoff.

julia_cs: Updated: added SLA note + retry guidance.

mike_oncall: Status page draft (to push to status.redwood.ai/incidents):
"Summary: Investigating elevated 5xx error rate impacting Everdawn on the EU dedicated cluster. Scope: Requests routed to dedicated-eu-cluster-3 for accounts pinned to that pool. Impact: intermittent failed requests and increased latencies for affected endpoints. Mitigation: rollback of recent model rollout in progress. ETA: 30–45 minutes. Updates: every 15 minutes or on milestone."

ashley_sre: Rollback canary completed, canary pod metrics look stable (error rate back to ~0.4%). Rolling forward full rollback now, scaling pods to replace failing ones.

incident-bot: Canary rollback succeeded. Proceeding with rollout rlbk-1768810001 -> stage=full.

sre-lead-omar: Good. Also set autoscaler min to current to avoid noisy scale events during recovery:
```
kubectl patch hpa dedicated-eu-3 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'
```

ashley_sre: Applied patch, scaling behavior stabilized. Observability: p95 latency trending down, error rate dropping to 1.2% across cluster. Continuing monitoring.

julia_cs: Sending short notification to Everdawn (sent by account-eng-evelyn):
"Sent: 2024-09-12T14:58Z — Short update: rollback in progress; error rate improving; next update in 20 minutes or earlier." :thumbsup:

account-eng-evelyn: Received ack from Everdawn ops: "thanks, keep us posted — we'll throttle retries client-side for 30 mins."

mike_oncall: Internal routing checklist for customer-impact comms (who to notify):
- CS urgent: @julia_cs (on thread)
- Account exec: @account-eng-evelyn
- Legal / compliance: draft only, TBD if incident escalates
- Sales: notify if SLA credit likely
- Exec oncall: ping only if outage > 2 hours or sustained >50% customer impact

julia_cs: Template for tailored granular notes (if needed):
"Impacted services: text-generation and chat endpoints pinned to dedicated-eu-cluster-3. Observed effect: intermittent 5xx responses; approximate affected request volume: ~12% of your traffic served by that pool. Mitigation steps taken: rollback to v1.7.2, replaced 4 pods, autoscaler min set to 10. Next update: <ETA or time>. Contact: evelyn@everdawn.co; Redwood primary: julia@redwood.ai."

ashley_sre: Full rollback finished at 15:05 UTC. Error rate now ~0.3%, p95 latency within baseline. Keeping monitoring for 30m before closing.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem owner: ashley_sre. Severity: Sev2.

derek_pm: Assigning postmortem action: verify model rollout gating (add runtime KV cache stress tests), and add rollout-guard to CI for dedicated pools.

sre-lead-omar: I'll own the rollout-guard PR.

julia_cs: Final customer follow-up draft to send once confirmed stable: 
"Update: We mitigated the issue by rolling back the recent model rollout for your dedicated EU pool. Error rates returned to baseline and service is stable. No data loss detected. We're investigating root cause and will share a follow-up postmortem with action items within 48 hours. — Redwood Inference (Evelyn and Julia)"

account-eng-evelyn: Everdawn asked for SLA impact estimate and postmortem timeline. I'll promise postmortem within 48 hours and estimate negligible SLA credit (will confirm).

mike_oncall: Next steps: 1) monitor 30m, 2) if stable, update status page to "resolved with monitoring" and send final customer note, 3) start postmortem.

incident-bot: Paging session closed for oncall-mike. Handoff window: active monitoring by ashley_sre until 1768813600.

ashley_sre: Monitoring ongoing. Will kick off postmortem doc and include logs + canary metrics.

julia_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll send the final customer message after 30m stability window. :white_check_mark:
